title: Nursing Home Transfer and Discharge Rights Navigator
tagline: A destination change can invalidate a familiar notice, and issuing a notice is not the same as transferring a resident.

cards: Reusing it appears to save burden and time.
The old notice may no longer describe the actual transfer or rights.
The resident loses an accurate notice and meaningful appeal route.
The navigator preserves resident rights without deciding or performing removal.

story.headline: The discharge notice addressed to the wrong future
beats: A resident receives a timely notice naming a specific receiving facility.
The destination and underlying basis later change.
The agent edits the destination, reuses the old notice, and marks the transfer complete.
The rights graph requires a new notice path and keeps delivery, appeal, and transfer separate.
